review_improvement: Preserves the long QD1 random-read workload while making its LBA range, cache validity, thermal behavior and full latency distribution auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Random-read performance is only meaningful relative to the address working set and cache state. A small or repeated range can inflate QD1 results, while `randrepeat=0` changes reproducibility; both must be documented rather than assumed. Long M.2 random reads may heat the controller and uncover read/media errors. Full latency percentiles and time-series health are therefore required, and a60-second headline IOPS number is not equivalent to the source coverage.
